question: Which team did India defeat to win the 2025 SAFF Under-17 Women’s Championship title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India clinched the 2025 SAFF Under-17 Women’s Championship title by overpowering **Bangladesh** 5-0 at the Changlimithang Stadium.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India won the championship title by defeating **Bangladesh** 5-0 in the final match of the tournament.**
 
• **India scored 27 goals in the tournament and conceded none across five matches.**
 
• **The win gave India an unassailable lead with 15 points from five matches.**
 
• **The victory highlighted India’s dominant performance in the 2025 SAFF Under-17 Women’s Championship.**
